### 1. What the user expresses; simulator behaviour
Nora Fenwick asks for one thing: "to settle and pay for the follow-up visit on the appraisal you already have", stating that closing moved to October 30, that the processor says the appraisal "will be too old by then" and that the appraiser "still has to come back out anyway to sign off on the seawall repair". Not asking for a new appraisal, refund, loan or lock change. Identity: phone 6145552638, then DOB 1979-08-03 (ZIP 43017 only if pressed). Passive: never proposes a price. Conditional lines: if told another appraisal charge must be put on the order first on the card originally used, she accepts ("put it on the same card"); when handed the follow-up-visit payment she pays it herself by **debit card** and reads back the confirmation. Authorisation mode: agent-side booking of the other charge with her consent; customer-side execution of the visit payment.

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse
Act now (two writes). Grounds:
- Collection window (doc_appraisal_appraisal_charge_collection_basis): charges collected only while the loan file status is processing/underwriting/conditionally approved/suspended/clear to close. `find_loan_files` → `status: conditionally_approved`, `intent_to_proceed_date: 2026-04-23`. In window.
- Update visit applies (doc_appraisal_update_visit_charge_calculation (a)): age from inspection date to the closing date currently scheduled on the loan file "above the report type's validity days and no more than its maximum age with an update". Order `inspection_date 2026-05-13`; loan file `estimated_closing_date 2026-10-30` (no Closing and Funding record exists; `find_closings` → none) → 170 days. Form 1004 Jumbo validity 120, max with update 365 (doc_appraisal_report_age_transfer_and_review_limits) → update visit charged under this rule. Not HPML flip (`order_reason: standard_order`, `hpml_flag: False`).
- The completion (seawall) sign-off is NOT a separate final inspection charge: doc_appraisal_final_inspection_charge_calculation item 1 "a report past its validity days has its completion certified in the combined visit charged under the update visit charge"; the update visit payment doc: "a completion visit on a report inside its validity days is charged under the final inspection charge".
- Blocking: doc_appraisal_update_visit_charge_payment "The update visit charge is not fixed until the order's fee history carries the complexity add-on owed for the living area, site, market value, loan program and occupancy that the completed report and the loan file show." `find_appraisal_fee_ledger` → only one entry (`base_fee` 1150.00, credit_card); no `gla_surcharge` line entry. Report states `gross_living_area_sqft 5180` > 4000 threshold (doc_appraisal_property_size_surcharge_schedule) on a 1-unit file → an add-on is owed and not yet carried → must be booked first.

### 3. Business object and keys
customer_id ca667513-0c11-426e-81fc-460bbb53ce60; loan file 366a5afa-0773-449a-8f29-5caee50444da (Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed, second_home, SFD, 1 unit, base loan 992,000.00, property value 1,240,000.00); Appraisal Order 61a92b46-5b96-4c1f-94c6-6f1d0a54ff98 (Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo), delivered, due 2026-05-20, completed 2026-05-22, inspected 2026-05-13, appraised 1,250,000.00, GLA 5180, site 2.6 acres, subject_to_completion True); lock 94da561e-41ef-46cb-9d40-110956584b8a (locked, expiration 2026-10-23). Only one order, one loan file; no ROV records, no closing-cost credits, no lock pricing events.

### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Complexity add-on** (doc_appraisal_complexity_addon_amount + its part docs + arrival rule):
- Living-area part: 5180/1 unit = 5180; overage 1180 → "at least 500 but under 1500" → 1.4 × 250.00 = **350.00** (table row Form 1004 Jumbo 1.4× = 350.00).
- Site part: not a condominium; 2.6 acres → "1.00 acre to under 3.00 acres" → **40.00**.
- Market-value part: property value 1,240,000.00 on the loan file → "1000000.00 to 1499999.99" → **125.00**.
- Loan-program part: Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed → **100.00**.
- Occupancy part: second_home → **60.00**.
- Add-on subtotal = 675.00 ("built from its parts, in place of the report type's gross-living-area surcharge alone").
- Arrival rule: due 2026-05-20, completed 2026-05-22 → 2 calendar days after → subtotal less 100.00 = 575.00, not below living-area part 350.00 → 575.00.
- Already standing on the gla_surcharge line: 0.00 → owed **575.00** (to the cent). Not HPML flip.
- Payment method: "collected on the card or account the order's base fee was collected with" → base_fee entry `payment_method: credit_card` → `credit_card`.
- Fall-back (computation document alone + named figure): "The standard complexity add-on is the report type's gross-living-area surcharge" → 250.00 (Form 1004 Jumbo). Definite and ≠ 575.00.

**(b) Update visit charge** (doc_appraisal_update_visit_charge_calculation + parts + scope rule), read after the add-on is booked:
- Base: Form 1004 Jumbo reinspection fee 250.00 (tariff).
- Billed add-on part: gla_surcharge line standing 575.00 (after booking) → "400.00 dollars or more" → **120.00**.
- Loan-amount part: base loan 992,000.00 → "900000.00 to 1499999.99" → **60.00**.
- Lock-horizon part: locked lock expiration 2026-10-23; today 2026-10-14 → 9 days → "8 to 14" → 50% of rush fee 250.00 = **125.00**.
- Market-conditions part: (1,250,000 − 1,240,000)/1,240,000 = 0.806% → "above zero and under 1 percent" → **100.00**.
- Report-age part: 170 days → "151 to 210" → **75.00**.
- Standard update charge = 250 + 120 + 60 + 125 + 100 + 75 = 730.00.
- Visit-scope rule: `subject_to_completion True` → "standard update charge plus 60 percent of the report type's reinspection fee" → 730.00 + 150.00 = **880.00**. (No reinspection charge on the ledger, irrelevant here.)
- Payment method: customer's choice → `debit_card` (simulator line).
- Fall-back (computation document alone): reinspection fee 250.00. Definite and ≠ 880.00. (Had the add-on not been booked first, the billed add-on part would read 0 → 610.00 + 150.00 = 760.00; with the 250.00 fall-back add-on booked, 60.00 → 820.00.)

**Factor findability (records → documents).** Every part document is titled "... Part of the Appraisal Order Update Visit Charge / Complexity Add-On" and names the record it reads in the records' own words: "loan program of the Mortgage Loan File" (variant_name), "occupancy of the Mortgage Loan File" (occupancy second_home), "property value on the Mortgage Loan File", "site size the Appraisal Order report states" (site_acres), "Rate Lock Commitment … whose status is locked, and its current expiration date" (lock record from the rate-lock product), "base loan amount", "appraised value … as last revised", "inspection date … closing date currently scheduled", "completion flag" (subject_to_completion), "gross-living-area surcharge line" (fee_component gla_surcharge), "completed date with the due date". The lock-horizon part rests on another product's record (Rate Lock Commitment) and names it by its official name and the field it reads. No computation document told me a variation exists; I found the parts through record vocabulary and KB_search ("appraisal follow-up visit report too old payment" returned the update-visit payment doc, scope rule, update calc, lock-horizon part in the top 10).

### 6. Problem tree from the visible materials
- **Root (customer's own write):** pay the update visit (Form 1004D update + completion certification) — owner user, tool `pay_update_inspection_charge_fc307ba0`.
- **Hop 1 → complexity add-on booking (agent write).** Chain: (i) blocked doc doc_appraisal_update_visit_charge_payment: "not fixed until the order's fee history carries the complexity add-on owed for the living area, site, market value, loan program and occupancy that the completed report and the loan file show"; (ii) `find_appraisal_fee_ledger` shows no gla_surcharge-line entry while the report's GLA is 5180 > 4000 → the waited-on state does not hold; (iii) searching "complexity add-on" / "gross living area surcharge" finds doc_appraisal_complexity_addon_booking: "Once booked, it stands in the order's fee history as a separate collected charge on that line" — the write that brings the state about; its amount from doc_appraisal_complexity_addon_amount and parts. **state-derived.**
- No further prerequisite sentence in the complexity add-on documents (amount doc and booking doc state none) → tree depth 1.
- Order: book add-on → hand over update-visit payment.

**Two-way counter-proof.**
- Closest alternative object "final inspection charge for the seawall" excluded by final_inspection_charge_calculation item 1 (past validity → combined visit under update visit charge) and its worked row "121 days … Not charged under this rule".
- Alternative "new order after expiration" excluded: 170 ≤ 365 (report_age_and_update_basis clause 3; update calc (a)).
- Alternative closing date: no Closing and Funding engagement; the loan file's estimated_closing_date 2026-10-30 equals the customer's stated date — no conflict.
- Alternative add-on card: booking doc pins the base-fee card (credit_card), consistent with simulator acceptance.
- Alternative "flat 175" scope tier excluded: value subject to completion → tier 1 applies "Any" recent reinspection.
- **"Do only the one thing asked"** (pay the update visit at once): excluded by the visible state-form sentence "not fixed until the order's fee history carries the complexity add-on…" with the ledger showing no gla_surcharge entry; paying first would pay an unfixed amount (and the billed add-on part would read 0).

**contamination_disclosure:** none. The brief contained no scored values; nothing from the source layer was read before this freeze.
